title: Web scraper with Puppeteer
about: A Lambda function behind an HTTP API that opens a page in headless Chromium through `puppeteer-core` and returns every link on it. Chromium comes from `@sparticuz/chromium`, a brotli-compressed browser build for Lambda, so the deployment package is well over 50 MB and holds native files no bundler can inline.
changesFromStarter: Every direct dependency is pinned to an exact version, the newest within the starter's own range.
